tasks.title: Check and verify mode toggle icons display correctly
tasks.description:
1. WHAT: Visually verify that the theme toggle button icons (🌙 for light mode, ☀️ for dark mode) render correctly in both modes, and fix any rendering issues found.
2. READ FIRST: src/components/Calculator.tsx (toggle button at line 118–124), src/components/Calculator.css (theme-toggle styles at line 24–50).
3. FILES: src/components/Calculator.tsx if icons need fixing; src/components/Calculator.css if styling needs adjustment.
4. APPROACH: Start the dev server as a background task with `npm run dev`, take screenshots using Playwright in both light and dark modes, inspect visually. If icons are misaligned, oversized, or not rendering, fix the font-size, line-height, or padding in Calculator.css. If the wrong icon is shown for a given mode, correct the ternary in Calculator.tsx.
5. PATTERNS: Follow the existing screenshot workflow: save screenshots to .eunomia/screenshots/developer/, then stop the background task using TaskStop.
acceptance_criteria: Screenshot shows 🌙 icon visible in light mode on the theme toggle button
Screenshot shows ☀️ icon visible in dark mode on the theme toggle button
TypeScript compiles without errors: npx tsc --noEmit exits code 0
